videos.title: Death Cap: The Mushroom Murders
videos.overview: Within days of attending a quiet family lunch in rural Victoria, Australia, three people are dead, one is fighting for their life in the ICU, and a fifth, Erin Patterson - the cook and host - becomes the leading suspect in a murder case.

videos.title: Death Cap: The Mushroom Murders
videos.overview: After almost two years, the trial of Erin Patterson takes over the former coal town of Morwell, Victoria. With a mountain of evidence withheld from the jury, two stories unfurl - what the jury knows, and what is kept hidden from them.

videos.title: Death Cap: The Mushroom Murders
videos.overview: Erin Patterson takes the stand and brings doubt to every element of the prosecution's case. But as the cross-examination delves deeper, she introduces new claims, details and deceptions - and these small lies ultimately prove her undoing.

videos.title: Top of the World
videos.overview: Through intimate firsthand accounts from its staff, this film revisits Windows on the World, the iconic restaurant atop the World Trade Center, exploring how it became a symbol of New York City before its story ended on September 11, 2001.

videos.title: Decades In Sports
videos.overview: In the 1990s, athletes' celebrity power transcends the world of sports; sports scandals are increasingly smeared across tabloid headlines, while Michael Jordan wins six titles and becomes one of the most recognized athletes in the world.

videos.title: Decades In Sports
videos.overview: As tensions between the USSR and the United States heat up in the 80s, so do sports rivalries; Evert vs. Navratilova and Bird vs. Magic in the NBA dominate their respective sports, while The Great One bursts onto the ice in the NHL.

videos.title: Decades In Sports
videos.overview: As cultural and political movements grow across the United States, their impact on sports is undeniable; women command a larger place on the American sports horizon, while free agency rebalances the dynamic between owners and players.

videos.title: Decades In Sports
videos.overview: National tragedy, historic comebacks and grand slams define the 2000s in sports; Tiger Woods in golf, the Williams sisters in tennis and a shakeup of one of the greatest baseball rivalries in history prove that sports belong to all Americans.

videos.title: Decades In Sports
videos.overview: Huge names emerge in sports in the 2010s, including LeBron James, Simone Biles and Steph Curry; as social media revolutionizes fan engagement, direct interaction and sports betting change the way viewers see celebrity athletes forever.
